provenance_candidate_lines: BoolQ Bangla (BN) is a question-answering dataset for yes/no questions, generated using GPT-4. The dataset contains 15,942 examples, with each entry consisting of a triplet: (question, passage, answer). The questions are naturally occurring, generated from unprompted and unconstrained settings. Input passages were sourced from Bangla Wikipedia, Banglapedia, and News Articles, and GPT-4 was used to

The dataset was manually reviewed by a human annotator (random samples), revealing an error rate of 1.33%, which was subsequently corrected. While efforts were made to minimize errors, there may still be a small portion of errors remaining in the dataset.
